date: Reviewed trial · 15 November 2026 · free sources only

finding.title: The denser photographs recover a connected camera model
finding.description: The latest shared-rig trial uses four closer source positions from 17 February. Recovered relative camera poses establish a sparse diagnostic; metric scale and walking surfaces remain unverified.

methods.title: Independent perspective crops

rigFigure.caption: Measured sparse geometry: 1,377 points; 1.49 px 95th-percentile observation error; 5.05° median physical-camera parallax. An independent native-model reload confirms the camera and point counts. Scale is arbitrary and surfaces remain unbuilt.

coverage.description: 3,076 source records across 9 complete local collections; 0 additional cameras within 50 m of the route compared with the earlier 167-record query.
coverage.caption: Both trial sequences remain west of the first route edge. Map positions come from contributor metadata; route proximity establishes no surface overlap, connected reconstruction or measured pedestrian floor.

nextSteps: Use the recovered cameras for a bounded surface reconstruction, checking held-out views, silhouette accuracy and capture artefacts before selecting a rendering method.
Find eastward surface overlap, then establish measured scale and a continuous pedestrian floor before a walking preview.
Keep the approved texture and lighting experience while testing landmark recognition, EN/ZH guidance and performance on the full six-sight route.
